text: じょしゅに　がくしゅうそうちを　もたせたぞ！

structure.jp: がくしゅうそうちを　もたせたぞ！
structure.en: I had carry an Exp. Share to you!

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.span: じょしゅに　がくしゅうそうちを　もたせた
patterns.explanation: The せる ending means making or letting someone do the thing, and that someone gets に. じょしゅに もたせた = 'I had my aide carry it'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, forceful way to announce something, used mostly by men. もたせたぞ = 'I had him carry it, you hear!'.
